hero.title: Practice IT interviews with AI personalized from your CV
hero.text: AI-SPEIS helps you practice in a safe environment, receive clear feedback, track progress, and prepare better for real interviews.

mascot.note: AI will ask based on your CV, target role, and confidence level.

highlights.title: Low-anxiety flow
highlights.text: Clear steps, calm guidance, no clutter

highlights.title: Easy review
highlights.text: Transcript, rubric, progress and next steps

features.title: A clear, effective interview practice experience
features.text: Every screen focuses on helping students understand the next action: upload a CV, start an interview, read the transcript, review feedback, and practice again.

cards.title: Upload CV and profile
cards.description: Import your CV, choose a target role, and let the system personalize questions from the start.

cards.title: AI mock interviews
cards.description: Practice by role, difficulty, and language with question sets close to real hiring scenarios.

cards.title: Transcript and review
cards.description: Revisit your transcript, spot answer gaps, and refine your content after each round.

cards.title: Actionable feedback
cards.description: Rubric-based scoring highlights strengths, gaps, and the next improvements to focus on.

cards.title: Progress tracking
cards.description: History, streaks, achievements, and progress charts help you see improvement clearly.

cards.title: Supportive community
cards.description: Join practice groups, share tips, and get vouchers and resources for recruiting season.

flow.title: From preparation to feedback in one learning flow
flow.text: The page is designed like a clear path so you never get lost in too many buttons and always know the next step.

steps.title: 1. Upload your CV and choose a goal
steps.text: Start with your CV, target position, and skills you want to improve.

steps.title: 2. Let AI generate the question set
steps.text: The system creates questions based on your CV, skills, and role fit.

steps.title: 3. Practice in the interview room
steps.text: Record with Mic, hear AI prompts with Voice, and practice safely through repeated rounds.

steps.title: 4. Review transcripts and common mistakes
steps.text: Every answer is saved so you can review, inspect mistakes, and refine your response.

steps.title: 5. Get rubric-based feedback
steps.text: Scores and notes are grouped by criteria so you know what to fix first.

steps.title: 6. Track long-term progress
steps.text: Streaks, charts, and milestones help you keep the practice habit going.

personalization.title: Personalized by CV, target role, and improvement gaps
personalization.text: AI-SPEIS uses your CV and target role to tune the question set, feedback tone, and practice checklist. New users can start quickly, while experienced users can go deeper into advanced practice loops.
rows: Dashboard for history, scores, and streaks
Quick search for transcripts, common mistakes, and fixes

community.title: A support system to help you practice consistently

cards.title: Practice reminders
cards.text: Set reminders to keep a steady practice rhythm before interview day.

cards.title: Clear milestones
cards.text: Every session adds a milestone so you can see your own progress.

cards.title: Healthy streaks
cards.text: Motivation is gentle, not stressful, and avoids excessive gamification.

cards.title: Guided learning path
cards.text: Move from CV, to questions, to transcript and feedback, step by step.

interviewRoom.title: A minimal interview room that is focused and easy to follow
interviewRoom.text: The practice screen keeps a centered layout with transcript, recording controls, voice output, rubric feedback, and progress status in one view.

cta.title: Ready to try your first mock interview session?
cta.text: Upload your CV, choose your target role, and let AI-SPEIS generate your first practice round.

pricing.title: Plans for learners
pricing.text: Choose a plan to unlock more practice features.
pricing.free: Basic experience with limited mock interviews per month.
pricing.pro: Unlimited practice, detailed analytics, and advanced AI features.
pricing.enterprise: For organizations, bulk customization, and API integration.
